subject: Your Netflix trial is ending soon
body:
Hi Aaryan,

Thanks for being a Netflix member. This is a courtesy notice that your free trial period is coming to an end. We hope you've been enjoying everything Netflix has to offer.

Over the past weeks we've shipped a number of improvements to make your experience better, including faster load times, a redesigned home surface, and improved recommendations tailored to your usage patterns. Our team works continuously to deliver value.

If you wish to continue uninterrupted, no action is required on your part. Your card on file will be charged CAD $22.99 in 22 days when the trial converts to a paid plan. To review or change your plan, visit your account settings page at any time.

We also wanted to remind you about our referral programme, community forums, and mobile apps.

Warm regards,
The Netflix Team

subject: Winter 2027 course enrolment closes
body:
Dear Student,

We hope this message finds you well as the term progresses. This communication is being sent to all students currently registered in the program.

As you may be aware, the academic calendar contains a number of important dates and administrative requirements. The department has recently updated several of its internal procedures, and we encourage all students to familiarise themselves with the revised documentation available on the portal. Students who have questions about these procedures are welcome to attend drop-in advising hours, which are held weekly in the main office. Please note that advising hours may shift during reading week.

Additional resources including workshops, peer mentoring, and writing support continue to be available at no cost. We strongly encourage students to take advantage of these services early in the term rather than waiting until deadlines approach.

Please note that winter 2027 course enrolment closes must be completed no later than 2 days from today. Late submissions cannot be accommodated under any circumstances.

Sincerely,
Academic Administration
